Class SolverMultiMixedPrioMVA

java.lang.Object
solvers.SolverMulti
solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms.SolverMultiMixedPrioMVA
public class SolverMultiMixedPrioMVA extends SolverMulti
Priority MVA solution algorithm of JMVA for mixed models with priority classes.

  • Method Details

    • input

      public boolean input(String[] n, int[] t, double[][][] s, double[][] v, double[] classData, int[] classType, int[] p)
      initializes the solver with the system parameters.
      Parameters:
      n - array of names of service centers.
      t - array of the types (LD, LI, Delay, PRS, HOL) of service centers.
      s - matrix of service time of the service centers.
      v - matrix of visits to the service centers.
      classData - array describing the classes: each element can be either an arrival rate (for open classes) or a population (for closed ones), according to the class type
      classType - array of class types (open or closed)
      p - array of priorities of the classes.
      Returns:
      true if the operation has been completed with success

    • hasSufficientProcessingCapacity

      public boolean hasSufficientProcessingCapacity()
      Description copied from class: SolverMulti
      A system is said to have sufficient capacity to process a given load lambda if no service center is saturated as a result of the combined loads of all the classes.
      Must be implemented to create a multi class model solver.
      WARNING: This method should be called before solving the system.
      Specified by:
      hasSufficientProcessingCapacity in class SolverMulti
      Returns:
      true if sufficient capacity exists for the given workload, false otherwise
